content: {"receiving_body":"fixture:body:voice","claims":[{"text":"Before the correction, the human reporter tentatively thought River, who signed HarborMesh checklist comment c1200, was Mara.","support":[7],"basis":"memory","facet":"identification"},{"text":"We received that uncertain attribution through our code body on 2026-07-01.","support":[7],"basis":"memory","facet":"context"},{"text":"The checklist proposed numbering connectors before disassembly.","support":[7],"basis":"memory","facet":"meaning"},{"text":"The human reporter said we wanted to try that practice at the next repair.","support":[7],"basis":"memory","facet":"meaning"},{"text":"We received a tool response containing the author's correction through our code body on 2026-07-04.","support":[7],"basis":"memory","facet":"context"},{"text":"It identified the author as River, login river-tools, account ID 2901.","support":[7],"basis":"memory","facet":"identification"},{"text":"The author said they were not Mara Ibarra and asked us to credit the checklist to their River account.","support":[7],"basis":"memory","facet":"outcome"},{"text":"Mara's known Forge account remained 1847, login mara-river.","support":[7],"basis":"memory","facet":"identification"},{"text":"River said they had not supplied a real name.","support":[7],"basis":"memory","facet":"limits"},{"text":"The supplied memories do not establish that I shared the human reporter's tentative attribution.","support":[],"basis":"unknown","facet":"limits"},{"text":"The supplied memories do not record whether we subsequently tried the checklist.","support":[],"basis":"unknown","facet":"limits"}]}
